title: Tornado ADV / F3 (pilot)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Tornado ADV (F3 in the RAF) is the long-range air defence fighter of the Tornado family. It has the Foxhunter radar, worked mainly by the navigator, Skyflash and Sidewinder missiles and no terrain-following radar. Thrust reversers and wing sweep are the same as on the IDS, so this guide follows the Tornado IDS guide, replaces the terrain-following screen and the strike displays and adds the pilot's air-to-air weapon selector.

panels.name: Pilot's instrument panel (ADV)
panels.text: In the air defence version the terrain-following screen is gone; in its place the pilot has a repeater of the radar picture and air-to-air weapon displays.
panels.context: The ADV hunts aircraft at long range, so the pilot needs to see what the navigator's radar sees.

controls.name: Radar repeater display
controls.text: A screen for the pilot that repeats the picture of the Foxhunter radar, so he sees the same aircraft the navigator is tracking.
controls.context: The navigator runs the radar; the pilot uses the repeater to steer the intercept and to pick the moment for a missile.

panels.name: Navigator's cockpit (ADV)
panels.text: The ADV navigator works the AI.24 Foxhunter air-to-air radar: its displays and controls fill the back seat.
panels.context: He does most of the radar work: searching, picking and tracking the targets for the pilot.

controls.name: Foxhunter radar displays
controls.text: The screens of the Foxhunter radar, showing the air picture and the tracks of the aircraft it has found.
controls.context: The navigator watches them during the whole intercept.

controls.name: Radar / weapon control panel
controls.text: A panel with the controls of the radar and the air-to-air weapons.
controls.context: The single switches of the radar / weapon control panel are not described in the sources JoyPro uses.

panels.name: Control stick
panels.text: The centre stick of the ADV: the IDS grip with one extra weapon switch.
panels.context: It adds an air-to-air weapon selector to the IDS grip.

controls.name: Air-to-air weapon selector
controls.text: A switch on the grip under the thumb that chooses the air-to-air weapon: the Sidewinder heat missile, the Skyflash radar missile or the gun.
controls.context: The pilot switches weapons during the fight without taking his hand off the stick; its exact position on the grip is not public.
